scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name "$CLOUDFLARE_PAGES_PROJECT" --branch "${CLOUDFLARE_PAGES_BRANCH:-main}" --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:app: npm run build && npx netlify deploy --prod --dir=dist
scripts.deploy:app:ci: npm run build && npx netlify deploy --prod --dir=dist --site "$NETLIFY_SITE_ID" --auth "$NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN"
